failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 14 days, despite PARKS mobility rising by more than 5 points week-on-week.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the last 28 days, despite both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT showing week-on-week increases.

candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above 10% change from baseline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days significantly increases, even while RESIDENTIAL mobility remains above 10% from baseline.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the next 7 days, even if TRANSIT mobility rises above -60% from baseline.
